timeline.text: Welcome to Regretting Something You Just Posted. I’ll guide you through each tapping point. At every point, you’ll hear a short phrase. Repeat it aloud, or quietly inside your head. Let’s begin.

timeline.ins: Begin tapping on the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I just posted something and I’m already regretting it.

timeline.ins: Now tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind keeps imagining how people will react.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m worried I revealed too much.

timeline.ins: Now tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I keep checking to see who has seen it.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body feels anxious waiting for a reaction.

timeline.ins: Now tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I want to take it back immediately.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: Part of me feels embarrassed already.

timeline.ins: Now tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can admit that I feel exposed right now.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: This is taking up a lot of space in my mind.

timeline.text: Take one easy breath. Notice whether anything has shifted, even slightly. If nothing has changed yet, that’s completely okay. Keep breathing, and we’ll continue.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I can let this post exist without controlling every reaction.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: People are far less focused on me than I imagine.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I can be honest online without it being a mistake.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I don’t need to track every response.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can settle while I wait.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can delete it or leave it, either is okay.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: One post doesn’t define how people see me.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I can trust that what I shared was genuine.

timeline.ins: Finish this round under your arm.
timeline.say: I can put my phone down for a while.

timeline.text: Take another slow breath. Notice what feels different now. You don’t need the feeling to disappear. See if there’s simply a little less pressure, or a little more choice in how you meet this moment.

timeline.ins: Return to the side of your hand.
timeline.say: I trust myself to show up honestly online.

timeline.ins: Tap the top of your head.
timeline.say: My mind can let this go.

timeline.ins: Move to the beginning of your eyebrows.
timeline.say: I’m allowed to be imperfectly myself in public.

timeline.ins: Tap at the side of your eyes.
timeline.say: I can focus on my actual life, not just reactions to it.

timeline.ins: Move under your eyes.
timeline.say: My body can relax about this.

timeline.ins: Tap under your nose.
timeline.say: I can handle whatever response comes.

timeline.ins: Move to your chin.
timeline.say: I don’t need everyone's approval.

timeline.ins: Tap your collarbones.
timeline.say: I’m someone who can be real, even online.

timeline.ins: Finish under your arm.
timeline.say: I’m ready to let this be finished.

timeline.text: Let your hands rest, and take one full breath. Notice how you feel now, without needing to judge it. Thank you for taking this time for yourself. Carry this steadiness with you as you continue.
